newsitem.title: UK: Shell sees chance of some refinery run cuts.
newsitem.headline: Shell sees chance of some refinery run cuts.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell Group said on Thursday it would have to consider the possibility of localised refinery run cuts after profit margins eased at the beginning of the eyar,
"We're not considering cutting runs, except possibly very locally," said Shell chairman John Jennings following the announcement of company annual results. "It's not a group strategy."
"There have been some localised run cuts ... there's no doubt refinery margins eased back in the early weeks of this year," Paul Skinner, oil products director said.
Higher distillation capacity in Korea had hurt Asian margins recently, Skinner said.
